blog.title: the grandma polka quest (SOLVED)
blog.body: ok so 3 weeks ago my grandma says larry, ur good w/ the computer, can u find the polka they played at my wedding. she doesnt know the name. she hums it. i type 'polka' in2 the search and get a million results and every single one is labeled 'weird al - polka'. so i download them. all of them. the Beast ran 4 six days straight and dad pointed a fan at it. i listened 2 like 300 polkas. i know things about accordions now that i cant unknow. file #212 was called 'metallica - enter sandman (live)' and i almost skipped it. it was the polka. the EXACT one. i burned it on a cd and wrote GRANDMA on it and drew a frog. she played it in the kitchen and danced w/ the dog and cried a little. then she said 'can u find the one from the reception.' so thats my october. its not stealing its sharing and sometimes its sharing w/ ur grandma.
